defs.def: located in the east or facing east 东方的；向东的；东部的

ex.s: The Saint Lukas is one of five government-sponsored medical trains that travel to remote towns in central and eastern Russia.
ex.t: “圣卢卡斯号”是五列政府资助的医疗列车之一，开往俄罗斯中部和东部的偏远城镇。

ex.s: Southbank, at an eastern bend in the Thames, is the center of British skateboarding, where the continuous crashing of skateboards left your head ringing .I loved it.
ex.t: 南岸，在泰晤士河向东的拐弯处，是英国滑板运动的中心，滑板不断的撞击声让你的脑袋嗡嗡作响。我爱上了那里。

ex.s: It runs for several hundred metres on the eastern coast of Northern Ireland.
ex.t: 它在北爱尔兰东海岸延伸数百米。

ex.s: The Bernina Express follows a route that runs from Eastern Switzerland to Northern Italy.
ex.t: 贝尔尼纳快车沿着从瑞士东部延伸到意大利北部的路线行驶。

ex.s: My family and I have managed to cross the North American continent, from western to eastern Canada, in two weeks!
ex.t: 我和家人已经成功穿越了北美大陆，从加拿大西部到东部，只用了两周时间！

ex.s: So, we're now in Newfoundland, the very eastern part of Canada and the end of out journey.
ex.t: 所以，我们现在在纽芬兰，加拿大的最东部，也是我们旅程的终点。

ex.s: The movements of the black and white pieces reflect the basic ideas of Eastern philosophy, according to Tu Ningning, who is in charge of the exhibition.
ex.t: 黑白棋子的走法反映了东方哲学的基本理念，展览负责人涂宁宁说道。

ex.s: The performance borrowed a lot from Chinese dance and music, so the Eastern influence on the ballet was clear.
ex.t: 这部作品大量借鉴了中国舞蹈和音乐，因此东方对这部芭蕾舞剧的影响清晰可见。

defs.def: connected with the part of the world that is to the east of Europe （欧洲以东的）亚洲国家的，东方国家的
